mode: independent read-only source review and synthetic local probes

findings.title: Interrupted vault update destroys previous ciphertext
findings.recommendation: Write immutable generation chunks, publish pointer last, serialize writes/index updates and bound counts; preserve legacy record until replacement commits.

retest.evidence: 31-device-storage-atomic8/8 passed: interruption beforepublication, globalserialization, Unicodebytebounds, legacy migration, boundedcorruptcounts, reclaimfirstwrite. Original actualDeviceStore faultprobe now oldRecordPreserved:true,mixedRecordAccepted:false,orphansAfterClear:0.

findings.title: Profile bearer and refresh tokens persist outside platform secure storage
findings.proof: Supabase createClient auth.storage receives AsyncStorage with persistSession:true; package default session serialization contains bearer/refresh credentials. No user data accessed.
findings.recommendation: Use chunked, crash-consistent SecureStore session adapter; explicit private keychain options; remove legacy AsyncStorage token and handle unavailable secure storage by failing closed.

retest.evidence: Supabaseauth now secure-only AtomicStore-backed sessionadapter with WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY and privatekeychainservice. Migration/logout wholeadapter serialized, legacyplaintext removed even onsecurefailure,8/8 tests pass without real tokens.

findings.title: Prepared payment not bound to native network context
findings.proof: Native dispatch forwards prepare/confirm and setNetwork independently; engine setNetwork does not clear prepared entries, confirmPrepared signs stored transaction against current connection; screen warning uses current network rather than preparation network. Source proof only, no live transaction sent.
findings.recommendation: Bind prepared request IDs to network generation at host boundary; invalidate/discard on network change and reject late prepares and old confirmations. Keep mirrored core unchanged.

retest.evidence: Independent actual-runtime/mock-engine approval probes pass stale network confirmation (0 engine calls), late preparation rejection/discard, in-flight network prepare rejection (0 calls), duplicate confirmation (1 call). Context-changing mutations are serialized and generation-bound; prepare/trust/confirm verify displayed network matches connection.

findings.title: Stale portfolio and missing token silently change payment to XRP
findings.proof: Effect .then(setPortfolio) commits out-of-order account/network reads; selectedToken is missing after refreshed tokens disappear, then ternary submits kind:xrp regardless of selected asset.
findings.recommendation: Latest-request correlation, clear portfolio on context changes, resolve selection explicitly and reject unknown/removed issued assets.

retest.evidence: Independent actualSendScreen source withsyntheticReacthooks/nativewallet harness: oldaccountportfoliorejected, editedlatepreparationdiscardedandreviewhidden, missingselectedassetdisabled, noXRPfallbackcall. /workspace/shared/red-team-probes/send-screen-result.json.

findings.title: Device erase always rejects due to confirmation literal mismatch
findings.recommendation: Use engine ERASE confirmation contract consistently and surface operation failure.

retest.evidence: Both Settings andUnlock now pass ERASE; Unlockshowsmatchingconfirmationfield and catchesfailure. Actualruntime syntheticERASEprobe accepted:true withoutwallet/KDF.

findings.title: Profile sign-out leaves native wallet unlocked
findings.proof: Both sign-out handlers only call supabase.auth.signOut, and WalletRoot has no auth observer to call wallet.lock. Architecture requires sign-out while locking.
findings.recommendation: Immediately lock local snapshot/runtime when signout begins, clear sensitive UI, then sign out backend and handle errors.

retest.evidence: Both profile and settings invoke signOutAndLock; helper test verifies snapshot and engine locking precede network logout even when network logout fails.

findings.title: Malformed null token row aborts whole backend sync
findings.proof: External array is cast UpstreamToken[] and .filter dereferences token.currency without nonnull/object checks; null row throws outside upstream catch. Local synthetic source probe, no production calls.
findings.recommendation: Shape-check each row and nested metadata before property access; bounded response bytes before JSON parse.

retest.evidence: tests/readiness/27-market-proxy.test.ts: null/array/malformed row and nested-metadata synthetic tests passed; sync now filters records and bounds streamed JSON bytes

findings.title: HTTPS logo guard accepts private-address and credential URLs
findings.proof: safeImageUrl accepts any https URL including https://127.0.0.1/logo.png and https://user:password@host/logo.png; new native remote image loader would fetch attacker-chosen destinations. No request issued.
findings.recommendation: Use exact curated image host allowlist with no auth/ports and reject local/private URLs; ensure logos remain untrusted display decoration and do not influence signing/trust.

retest.status: fixed for native market/logo boundary and literal unsafe URLs
retest.evidence: 21 relevant market tests passed; native logos derive issuer+currency identity and use first-party fixed-path proxy. Proxy requests fixed api.xrpl.to origin, rejects redirect, caps raster bytes/dimensions/concurrency/cache. Legacy safeImageUrl rejects credentials, literal IPs, local names, SVG and nonHTTPS.
retest.limitation: Legacy web safeImageUrl still accepts arbitrary public DNS names; it does not resolve DNS or guard against public-name DNS mapping to private hosts. Native market does not use those arbitrary URLs.

findings.title: Invalid null market identity passes snapshot cache validation
findings.recommendation: Require nonnull valid derived identity and exact string ID before accepting cache/proxy assets; add null-ID regression.

retest.evidence: Actual source probe now nullIdentitySnapshotAccepted:false and21/21 market tests pass; validator requires nonnull canonical identity, exact stringid andpositivefetchedAt.

findings.title: Anonymous market polling interval bypassed by focus/manual refresh
findings.recommendation: Set minimum request cooldown to600000ms for anonymous direct mode and60000ms for approved proxy; enforce in service for all triggers and rate-limit retries, not only hook interval.

retest.evidence: MarketClient minimumRefreshMs configurable; native chooses600000ms anonymous/60000ms proxy. Independent actual-source probe10 requests61sec apart now loads1;21/21 relevanttests pass.

findings.title: Hiding Testnet changes displayed network without switching native connection
findings.recommendation: At nativehost mark preferencesmutation asnetworkchange barrier andsynchronize engine.setNetwork to effectivegetState().network.id beforeallowingnewprepares. Keepmirrorcoreuntouched.
findings.probeScope: Actual runtimeandengine withpublic MemoryStoreprefs only; uninitializedwallet;noKDF,secrets orWebSocketconnect.

retest.status: fixed in current working tree with fail-closed recovery
retest.evidence: Actual public-preferences probe now display=mainnet, connection=mainnet after hiding Testnet. Failed durable network write can still leave mirrored engine state mismatched, but native prepare/trust/confirm refuse it before any engine account/vault/signing access; actual failure probe returns wallet-or-network-changed error. 33-native-approval-security9/9 passed including mismatch0enginecalls.
retest.limitation: Underlying mirrored engine mismatch after storage write failure is not changed; native host blocks sensitive transaction methods until a successful explicit network selection resynchronizes state.

releaseGate: Production candidate shares decrypted engine heap with UI and exposes signing/recovery. Full native isolated signing boundary remains documented release prerequisite; allowlist alone is not isolation.

independentRetest.additionalProductObservation: Foreground quotes now refresh only while screen focused and AppState active. Anonymous10min/proxy60sec intervals are also enforced by service against all manual/focus triggers. RED10 independent probe passes.

additionalActualSourceProbes: failed network persistence blocked before wallet access

finalReview: All eleven identified findings are fixed within native host/market scope in the current working tree and independently retested. Approved isolated native signing boundary and real physical-device security/performance validation remain release prerequisites. No claim of a complete penetration test or physical-device audit.
limitations: Provider approval and server key still required for live issued-token logos and first-party cached redistribution.
Native isolated-signing boundary remains a production-release prerequisite.
Full vault-backed native flows, physical crash persistence and representative release-device performance are not verified.
Backend limits/cache are per process, requiring an aggregate deployment budget.
Legacy browser image URL guard is not DNS-aware; native service uses fixed origins.

mainIntegration.strategy: merge commits preserve existing history; no native binary release
